acpira.conf.defaultAgent: The default agent for new sessions
acpira.conf.language: Interface language; auto follows VS Code
acpira.conf.agents: Add custom ACP agents: `{ "<id>": { "name": "display name", "command": "executable", "args": ["..."], "login": "login command" } }`
acpira.conf.compactAtTokens: When context usage after a turn (the agent's reported usage.used) reaches this many tokens, /compact is sent automatically. Only applies to agents that report usage and offer a /compact command; models with a smaller context window are the agent's own lookout
acpira.conf.autoCompact: Send /compact automatically once over the threshold (turn off to compact by hand from the context panel only)
acpira.conf.hiddenOptions: Option families hidden from the menus (models / reasoning levels…): `{ "<agent>": { "<configOption id>": ["<family name>", ...] } }`. Toggle them on the agent page in Acpira settings; hand-editing is rarely needed
acpira.conf.appearance.surface: Surface: hairline thin lines / tonal borderless layering / stroke outlines
acpira.conf.appearance.toolLine: Tool line: text only / with icon / icon + meta
acpira.conf.appearance.fold: Process-line folding: keep the whole turn in one fold showing the current action while running and the elapsed time when done, click to expand / fold read-only actions only (edits and commands stay visible)
